dedupe_keys.name: spatial focused multimodality analysis in the city of lisbon

description: The source explicitly describes a built software tool that helps specialists identify inconsistencies in Lisbon’s public-transport network. It evaluates spatiotemporal multimodality using Gini and Herfindahl indices within traffic-analysis zones, alongside available situational context. Related publications report higher multimodal use around central traffic-generation and attraction areas. The tool’s implementation is established by the thesis abstract, but no separate package, interface or licence is verified. The metadata catalogue mistakenly assigns this thesis the same institutional URL as a different bus-optimization thesis; that URL is withheld as an unresolved identity conflict. Coverage is limited to the source-described systems and experiments. The related Zenodo deposit provides descriptive metadata, with restricted document or data access and licence label not stated. Document rights do not establish software rights or access to the underlying observations. Only full descriptive metadata, file inventories and the project metadata catalogue were reviewed; no underlying measurements, code, paper or model archive was opened.
